title: Vision Transformer: The JFT-300M Scaling Breakthrough

beats.text: Staring at individual pixels is for amateurs; splitting images into 16x16 patches makes them speak transformer language.

beats.text: CNNs choke on global context, forcing local filters to hallucinate relationships across massive images like a nearsighted microscopist.
